about: Stage 3 clip picks for scene C (2026-10-21 autonomous run). Frame id -> chosen file (relative to media), in/out seconds inside that file, and what the stage 4 assembly needs to know. Every take, prompt and credit is in shots.md; the spend is in scripts/gpom/second-half-video/ending/ledger.json.
engine: Omni 1.1 Flash, Frames (start frame only), 16:9, 720p, x1; 1280x720 24 fps; clips carry Omni's own audio (mute on the timeline)

C01.note: Kai round 1 (bc1): new shot from inside the bunker past the wary faces (the old lady lit by the doorway, silent, turns her head away at ~7 s) to Maddie alone outside the doors, facing in. Beacon pulses (its glow lands on the doors). Maddie's 'Go on. I promise you'll be okay.' / 'You've got my word.' go over it with the beacon pulse in post; no lip-sync.
C01.alt: c01r1-t1.mp4 (reject: Omni flew a string of pennants up off the robot from ~0.5 s)
C01.superseded: C01-t1.mp4 (round 0: the lady straightening the bunting, 'Go on, then. You lead.')

C01b.note: Kai round 1 (bc1): the first two (a man shading his eyes, a woman) edge out of the doors onto the concrete; more follow behind them from ~3 s; Maddie in the left foreground, beacon pulses at ~1 s, the torn bunting stays low on her wheels.

C02.note: Review round 1 re-roll: a light breeze, the cloth hangs limp, nothing rises from the robot. No pennant pole; Maddie leaves frame left at ~7 s.
C02.alt: C02-t1.mp4 (round-0 pick: Omni grew a pole of pennants on her rear from ~1.5 s); C02-t3 rejected (the bunting streamed across the whole foreground)

C04b.note: One 8 s clip held the whole 17-word punchline: she turns to Derek and says it deadpan. 'She keeps talking until the very end' bought the length but also the invented tail; drop that clause next time.

talking.fit: phrase 1: voice 0-2.2 (whisper puts 'Doesn't' at 0.0-1.12, so the take likely has a quiet lead-in; measure the onset) over ~1.6 s = up to x1.375, check after the onset; phrase 2: voice 1.56 s over ~2.1 s of mouth (x0.75: voice shorter than mouth, fine, let it end early or tempo 0.85)
talking.look: 6.0-8.0: he turns his head to her, a flat look, mouth shut. Cut: C05 0-5.3 (his line) -> C04b (her punchline) -> C05 ~5.8-8.0 (the look)

He's been working on this one...' play over it (Derek among the backs: no lip-sync).
